scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @edutrack/backend && npm run build -w @edutrack/frontend
scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @edutrack/backend" "npm run dev -w @edutrack/frontend"
scripts.dev:full: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n db,api,web -c yellow,cyan,magenta "npm run db:local -w @edutrack/backend" "wait-on tcp:127.0.0.1:27017 && npm run dev -w @edutrack/backend" "npm run dev -w @edutrack/frontend"
scripts.seed: npm run build:shared && npm run seed -w @edutrack/backend
scripts.create-admin: npm run build:shared && npm run create-admin -w @edutrack/backend
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test -w @edutrack/backend && npm run test -w @edutrack/frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck -w @edutrack/backend && npm run typecheck -w @edutrack/frontend
